convergence.comparison: pixelmatch threshold 0.1 (harness convention), per-state budget 1.0% (dispatch default); targets = NORMALIZED prototype, Chromium 145.0.7632.6 (playwright 1.58.1), deviceScaleFactor 2, layout width 1280 (contract storyViewport width), --disable-lcd-text, --force-color-profile=srgb, reducedMotion, network blocked, Heebo served locally from pencil/designs/fonts/Heebo-VariableFont_wght.ttf, fonts.ready awaited, pointer parking AFTER drive steps (v002 rig fact, carried), double-shot self-consistency pixel-identical per state. ENV-FACT CORRECTIONS (promote): (1) the v002 note's 'Chromium 151.0.7922.34 (playwright 1.58.x)' pairing does not reproduce — playwright 1.58.1 ships Chromium 145.0.7632.6; Chromium 151.0.7922.34 ships with playwright 1.62.0; both browsers rendered this content pixel-identically, so the pairing drift is cosmetic for measurement. (2) NEW RIG FACTS (cost the calibration time): the v4.13 standalone's #uiDp1 sits at a FRACTIONAL document origin (y=2705.25 CSS) — Chromium snaps paint to the device grid, so a naive clip banks a 1-device-px backdrop sliver and shifts every edge (~5%/state false delta); fullPage (captureBeyondViewport) rasters snap the half-pixel UP while in-viewport rasters snap DOWN, and fullPage capture CLAMPS at integer scrollHeight, amputating the open popover's bottom device row (popover bottom 2993.25 vs scrollHeight 2993). Working recipe: viewport TALLER than the document (1280x3200 — layout is width-driven), non-fullPage screenshot of the integral-CSS clip, then device-exact crop at floor(fractional-origin * dsf).
convergence.captureGeometry: Closed states: frame = contract root #uiDp1 (200x36). Open states: frame = root ∪ popover overflow (252x288 — 36 trigger + 4 gap + 248 popover), matching the states.json declared land-stage obligation that the story wrapper enclose the open popover. The union clip admits sibling-widget bleed (the demo box's slider column edge, page context outside the contract root) into the strip right of the 200px trigger — present identically in every open-state target, counted against the budget, not reproduced in the frames (the .pen paints $sem-background-main there).
convergence.iterationNotes: It1: v003 generated from the converged v002 approved document — carried-frame geometry re-verified node-by-node against the fresh v4.13 normalized render (42/42 day text positions match to 0.06px; v4.13's markup deltas — heading-as-button, tooltip removal — are paint-invisible in these frames), plus the v4.12g .oth ink rebind (45 nodes -> $sem-text-faint) and three new year-grid frames authored from measured normalized-render geometry (24 year cells 56x30.33 on the 4x6/2px grid at inline height 192 = the date grid's; 2026 pill; 2026-cell focus ring; August-2027 zero-leading grid). Rig recalibration preceded the first honest compare (fractional-origin snapping + fullPage clamp, see comparison — infrastructure, not authoring; budget untouched). It1 compare: 7/9 pass at v002-caliber residuals (default 0.104% = v002's exact number); both year-grid states fail at ~1.7-2.0% with the delta clustered on the 24 four-digit year texts — pen renders the 13px digit runs ~1 CSS px wider (start-aligned) and 0.5 device px higher than the browser. It2: letterSpacing -0.25 and y +0.25 on all 48 year text nodes (both year frames) -> 9/9 pass, worst state 0.716%. The v001/v002 per-word letterSpacing compensations on carried strings hold verbatim.
